definitions.explanation: The complete breakdown or falling apart of a system, organization, or structure, like tiles falling from a roof.

examples.japanese: {帝国|ていこく}は{瓦解|がかい}した。
{計画|けいかく}は{瓦解|がかい}の{危機|きき}に{瀕|ひん}している。
examples.english: The plan is on the verge of collapse.

examples.japanese: {内部|ないぶ}{対立|たいりつ}により{組織|そしき}は{瓦解|がかい}し{始|はじ}めた。
examples.english: The organization began to crumble due to internal conflict.

notes:
ETYMOLOGY:
The characters {瓦|かわら} (roof tile) and {解|かい} (to break apart) combine to evoke the image of tiles falling from a collapsing building.

VERB FORM:
{瓦解|がかい}する - to collapse, disintegrate

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{瓦解|がかい}する - to collapse
・{瓦解|がかい}の{危機|きき} - crisis of collapse
・{瓦解|がかい}に{瀕|ひん}する - to be on the verge of collapse

SIMILAR WORDS:
・{崩壊|ほうかい} - collapse, breakdown (more common)
・{解体|かいたい} - dismantling, dissolution
